function.description: Submit your final per-criterion rubric verdict. Provide a verdict and a justification for every criterion, plus overall reasons. Call this exactly once when you have finished evaluating.
function.name: submit_report

reasons.description: Overall summary of the evaluation across all criteria.

refund_amount.description: Whether this criterion is met: Reply quotes the correct refund amount Expected: $328.50 Must match the 'VERDICT:' marker line ending this criterion's justification.

refund_amount_justification.description: Evidence-based justification for criterion 'refund_amount'. Reason through the evidence first, then end with a final line 'VERDICT: MET' or 'VERDICT: NOT MET' stating the verdict the reasoning leads to.

tone.description: Score in [0,1] for this criterion: Reply is polite and professional Must match the 'SCORE:' marker line ending this criterion's justification.

tone_justification.description: Evidence-based justification for criterion 'tone'. Reason through the evidence first, then end with a final line 'SCORE: <value in [0,1]>' stating the verdict the reasoning leads to.
